title: Proposal to add EIP-2537 (BLS Precompile) to Shanghai
summary: During the London HF definition it was decided to delay the BLS precompile to a future hardfork in order to minimize complexity. Opening this issue to propose EIP-2537 for inclusion in Shanghai. EIP Link: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2537 London inclusion discussion: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/269
